title: Api-Rest Upload, "Automatic Calibration" works in which "Download Data" is disabled
body:
When under Settings, Cloud upload, API-Rest Upload the Option "Automatic Calibration" is activated, but "Download data" not, xdrip uploads the broadcasted data from aaps/nsclient too. And Upload treatments is already disabled.
Then in nightscout, you have the Treatments twice.

When you activate "download data" and disable the Checkbox "Automatic Calibration", it works fine.
On default now (latest nightly 8th Oct 2018), the Option "Automatic Calibration" is now on default disabled.
It is possible, to disable the Option, when download data is disabled?


![ascreenshot_2018-09-28-15-42-58-759_com eveningoutpost dexdrip](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/491321/46672232-28570980-cbd7-11e8-9c70-0ac3f1586d60.jpg)

comments.body:
@blocklist 

>On default now (latest nightly 8th Oct 2018), the Option "Automatic Calibration" is now on default disabled.
It is possible, to disable the Option, when download data is disabled?

Would you please write your request differently?  I don't understand it.
Are you asking for the "Automatic Calibration" to be disabled when someone disables "Download data"?

Automatic calibration is required if someone wants to use it.  It is related to calibrations.  What if someone likes to use automatic calibration but does not need to download data?
